groups.sentence: Instructors learn the reporting and student conduct procedures before misuse occurs.
The institution establishes and communicates procedures and guidelines for handling AI misuse.
Instructors report suspected AI misuse to the designated academic integrity or conduct office, where it is recorded.
Instructors handle suspected AI misuse through the institution's existing formal academic integrity or conduct procedures.
The designated office or dean investigates and resolves reported AI violations under established integrity procedures.
Instructors include evidence, documentation and an explanation of the suspected violation in their report.
Instructors consult the conduct office, honor committee or other designated contacts with questions about suspected misuse.
Instructors submit the required report form within the stated deadline, one per violation.
Instructors report promptly, including first-time or repeat offenses, so the university can record and track cases.
Instructors may resolve concerns informally or impose an academic sanction under the applicable guidelines.
Instructors do not impose their own sanction or grade penalty before the deciding office makes a finding.
Instructors notify the student of the allegation and gather evidence before submitting the report.
Instructors do not discuss the suspected violation with the student or their chair.
Instructors do not run student work through an AI detection tool.
Students may receive informal violations, which are not stored in the university database, and formal ones, which are.
